title: Reading a bounded memory address
statement: Let $W$ be a word size, let $Z$ specify a space limit, and suppose $m$ stores the encoded value of $\sigma_{\mathrm{mem}}(a)$ at each natural-number address $a<Z.\mathrm{lim}.\mathrm{space}$. For any integer address $a$ with $0\le a<Z.\mathrm{lim}.\mathrm{space}$, the value of $m$ at address $a$ is the encoding of $\sigma_{\mathrm{mem}}(a)$, where the address is viewed as a natural number.
